title: belvala dodecapetala
intro: Belvala dodecapetala, commonly known as the "Himalayan Chrysanthemum", is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, cold, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Belvala dodecapetala are attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of fever, pain, and congestion. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
